customAnimations.name: glowPulse
customAnimations.keyframes: @keyframes glowPulse { 0% { opacity: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(255,0,200,0) } 60% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 48px rgba(255,0,200,.65) } 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255,0,200,.35) } }

customAnimations.name: shimmerSweep
customAnimations.keyframes: @keyframes shimmerSweep { from { background-position: -200% center; color: #7df9ff } to { background-position: 200% center; color: #ffffff } }

customAnimations.name: spinIn
customAnimations.keyframes: @keyframes spinIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-180deg) scale(0.4) } to { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(0) scale(1) } }
